title: NxControl
description:
NxControl is an advanced staff plugin that lets OP players control players or mobs using simple keybinds, with GUI, bossbars, and freeze system built-in.
It’s lightweight, powerful, and perfect for moderation, trolling, or cinematic gameplay.
body:
**Native Major MC Version:
1.21
Tested Major MC Versions:
1.171.181.191.201.20.61.21**
Additional Features:
✔ Only OP can use control
✔ Cannot control yourself
✔ Supports Players & Mobs
✔ Particle animation when control starts
✔ Totem sound effect on activation
✔ Dual BossBar system (Controller + Target)
✔ Freeze system integrated
✔ Clean disconnect handling (no bugged control left behind)
✔ Automatic bossbar removal
✔ Lightweight and optimized (no heavy async tasks)
✔ Safe task cancellation system
**Controls:
SHIFT + Right Click
→ Start controlling a player or mob
SHIFT + Left Click
→ Shows online players
/control
→ Open control GUI**
